parole.significato: angel wings (pastry shaped into twisted ribbons, deep-fried and sprinkled with powdered sugar)
parole.testo: Unadapted borrowing from Venetan gróstołi, plural of gróstoło, from Latin crustulum (“confectionery, sweet”), diminutive of crustum (“cake”). Cognate to Italian crostolo.
Borrowed from Venetan nono (“grandfather”), from Latin nonnus (“monk; tutor; old person”).
